scientific_integrity: Exact four-state Markov-chain and elementary derivative-sign proof; finite checker corroborates the formulas but does not certify historical originality or replace the infinite-parameter argument.
scientific_limitations: Two types, uniform acquisitions, fixed total loss budget strictly between zero and one, with completion checked after all erasures. Broader cache and Markov reliability literature may contain an equivalent statement.
title: Two distinct allocation bifurcations for a two-type careless collector
